criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Inspect every frozen diagnostic and turntable frame against references; silhouette, construction, proportions and materials must meet the brief. Features: Complete soft lenticular discoidal E.ludwigi animal with radial subdivisions, continuous upper and lower surfaces and soft unarmoured margin; Paired relatively stout short DENDRITIC ORAL tentacles arising from one off-centre VENTRAL mouth; separate nearby off-centre ventral anus; Clockwise dorsal-view internal gut has short pharynx, broad stomach arc and narrow terminal intestine; visible as FLUSH COLOR-CODED TEACHING PROJECTION on dorsal body, not natural external exposed hose; No stalk, marginal jellyfish tentacle curtain, bell, shell, eyes or Rotadiscus-specific structures. Scope: Evidence-informed WHOLE Eldonia ludwigi living-reconstruction teaching visualization. Complete soft animal retained, not isolated disc shell. Nominal150mm disc diameter is illustrative within museum reported maximum, not specimen replica. Internal gut shown as a flush color-coded dorsal anatomical projection, explicitly NOT natural skin coloration, transparency assertion, exposed organ or raised external hose. Mouth and anus physically ventral and off-centre. Body thickness, exact posture, colors and fine branch geometry inferred. Cambroernid/stem-ambulacrarian affinity is a supported phylogenetic hypothesis, not settled extant phylum; benthic versus pelagic ecology and mobility remain uncertain. No claim of settled jellyfish-like free-swimming ecology.

concept_decisions: Actual ImageGen pixels inspected: retain shallow full soft disc, radial sectors and two branched ventral oral tentacles. REJECT the concept dorsal visible anus and its misdrawn gut arrow; only flush projection on dorsal surface, actual anus and mouth underside. Projection geometry follows clockwise path viewed from +Z: mouth/pharynx at angle0 near +X, sweeps decreasing angle through lower hemisphere (broad stomach) then upper hemisphere and terminal narrower intestine toward separate ventral anus. Projection is face-material annotation with zero raised tube geometry. Two oral tentacles below disc project anteriorly enough for oblique hints; supplemental bottom diagnostic separately exposes both dendritic branches and off-centre openings. Radial pleats shallow irregular and continuous, no rigid pie-wedges or shell ribs. No labels in exported geometry; metadata explicitly declares teaching projection.
